description: This file defines an abstract Java class `XmlAbstractWidgetVisitor` used for generating XML representations of widget components in the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides utility methods to visit and write widget attributes, images, links, and parameters, serving as a base for more specific widget visitors.

classes.name: XmlAbstractWidgetVisitor
classes.description: An abstract base class for traversing widget structures and generating XML output, with utility methods for writing attributes and nested widget components.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns the Appendable writer used for output.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Overloaded methods to write various types of attribute values to the XML output.

methods.name: visitImage
methods.description: Writes an <image> element with its attributes.

methods.name: visitLink
methods.description: Writes a <link> element, including nested image and parameters if present.

methods.name: visitLinkAttributes
methods.description: Writes attributes for a link element.

methods.name: visitModelWidget
methods.description: Sets the name attribute for a widget if present.

methods.name: visitParameters
methods.description: Writes a collection of <parameter> elements with their attributes.
